data.name: Raghukul
data.gender_notes: Raghukul is used as a unisex name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Raghukul is recorded with the meaning “Descendant of Raghu”. Raghukul is a Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. name meaning “Descendant of Raghu”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Raghukul expresses “Descendant of Raghu”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

in_sanskrit.name: रघुकुल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Raghu was a legendary king in Hindu mythology, and the Raghukul is the dynasty that he founded.

in_hindi.name: रघुकुल
in_hindi.long_meaning: रघु एक प्राचीन राजा थे और रघुकुल उनका वंश है।

in_tamil.name: ரகுகுலம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ரகுவம் ஒரு பொருள் காணப்பட்ட பொறுப்புக்காள் ஆக இருந்தார் அவன் மக்கள் எனும் ரகுகுலம் அவனுக்கு வம்சம் ஆகும்.

in_telugu.name: రఘుకులం
in_telugu.long_meaning: రఘు మహారాజ యే మహారాజ అద్భుత కర్మలు చేసింది. అతే రఘు మహారాజ కు జన్మించిన ప్రజలం రఘుకులం అని అడుగుస్తుంది.

in_marathi.name: Raghukul
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Descendant of Raghu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Raghukul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Raghukul refers to the lineage or dynasty of King Raghu, an ancient king in Hindu mythology known for his generosity and righteousness.

in_bengali.name: Raghukul
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Descendant of Raghu
in_bengali.long_meaning: Raghukul একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Raghukul refers to the lineage or dynasty of King Raghu, an ancient king in Hindu mythology known for his generosity and righteousness.
